provenance_note: Response shape taken from GitHub's documented REST/GraphQL behaviour, not recorded: recording it would need a mutating call, which this lane may not make. Header values are illustrative and follow the recorded read fixtures. A secondary rate limit answers 403 with a retry-after header while x-ratelimit-remaining is still above zero, which is what separates it from primary exhaustion.

body.message: You have exceeded a secondary rate limit. Please wait a few minutes before you try again. If you reach out to GitHub Support for help, please include the request ID 0000:000000:0000000:0000000:00000000.
